verdict.rationale: Bird & Bird is an international law firm offering legal advisory services plus a few client-facing document-automation tools (questionnaire-based SCC and Term Sheet generators, a HighQ-hosted deal room). A developer-style sandbox for testing without touching production data is not a fair axis for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows the firm ships an API or developer platform where such a sandbox would apply; the llms.txt and OpenAPI probes all return 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
